name: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
summary:
Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) reported earnings of $2.09 per share on revenue of $13.38 billion for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.94 per share on revenue of $13.12 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $1.98 per share. The company beat expectations by 5.56% while revenue grew 44.68% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects fourth quarter revenue of $16.49 billion to $17.51 billion. The current consensus revenue estimate is $16.03 billion for the quarter ending December 31, 2026.

“We delivered a record quarter with revenue exceeding the high end of our guidance as Data Center segment sales nearly doubled year-over-year,” said Dr. Lisa Su, AMD chair and CEO. “Demand for our Instinct and EPYC products continued to strengthen, and we expect growth to accelerate further in the fourth quarter as we scale Helios and ‘Venice’ production. With our leadership product portfolio and deep customer and supply chain relationships, we are confident in our ability to sustain very strong revenue growth and expanding profitability over the coming years.”

Advanced Micro Devices Inc is a semiconductor company with facilities around the world. It operates in two segments: Computing Solutions and Graphics and Visual Solutions.
subject: Advanced Micro Devices Beat Expectations, Sees Revenue Above Estimates

The company also said it expects fiscal 2027 revenue of $72.0 billion to $82.0 billion. The current consensus revenue estimate is $67.7 billion for the year ending June 30, 2027.

“Supermicro’s transformation into a Total AI and IT Datacenter Solution provider continues to accelerate, delivering record revenue of $19.9 billion for the first quarter fiscal 2027,” said Charles Liang, Founder, President, and CEO of Supermicro. “DCBBS is driving significant value for our customers—from gigawatt-scale datacenters down to single-container PODs—which, including our expanding software, proactive service, and networking solutions, is enhancing profitability and long-term shareholder value. Through key enterprise partnerships and expanding global production capacity, we are making AI infrastructure faster to deploy, superior up-time and more cost-effective for our customer base.”

Super Micro Computer Inc is a server technology and green computing company. It develops and provides high performance server solutions based upon an modular and open-standard architecture.
subject: Super Micro Computer Beat Expectations, Sees Revenue Above Estimates
